name: File Storage / Shared Volume
description: File storage or a shared volume — also called a network file share, NFS/SMB/CIFS mount, NAS, shared drive, or persistent volume — network-attached storage for documents and application files. Mounted by services and users for shared read/write. The place to look for the file share, shared/network volume, NAS, mounted file system, or where documents and files are stored on disk.
